scripts.build: vp run prepare:local-cli && vp run --filter './apps/*' --filter './examples/*' build
scripts.format: vp fmt && vp exec biome format --write apps examples docs .github biome.json packages/core/CHANGELOG.md packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md packages/create-routa-ts/CHANGELOG.md
scripts.format:check: vp fmt --check && vp exec biome format apps examples docs .github biome.json packages/core/CHANGELOG.md packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md packages/create-routa-ts/CHANGELOG.md
scripts.generated:check: vp run prepare:local-cli && vp run --filter './examples/*' build && vp exec node scripts/check-generated.mjs
scripts.prepare:local-cli: vp run build:packages && vp exec node scripts/link-local-cli.mjs
scripts.quality: vp run check && vp run typecheck && vp run test
scripts.release: vp run prepare:local-cli && vp run quality && vp run build && vp run pack:check && vp exec changeset publish
scripts.typecheck: vp run build:packages && vp run --filter './packages/*' --filter './apps/*' typecheck
scripts.verify: vp run check && vp run typecheck && vp run test && vp run generated:check && vp run --filter './examples/*' check && vp run --filter './examples/*' openapi:check && scripts/scaffold-error-smoke.sh && vp run pack:check
scripts.check:biome: vp exec biome lint --config-path=biome.framework.json && vp exec biome check apps examples docs .github biome.json packages/core/CHANGELOG.md packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md packages/create-routa-ts/CHANGELOG.md
